system.description:
Flurry Technique

As a bonus action, you can spend 4 Discipline to enter a heightened state of focus, which requires concentration as if you were concentrating on a Jutsu of B-Rank. While concentrating, you gain two of the following benefits of your choice:

Your speed is increased by +20 feet.

You gain a +2 bonus to your AC.

You gain advantage on one saving throw of your choice.

You gain one additional Action on each of your turns. It can only be used to take a Skill based action, Dash, Disengage or make a single weapon attack.

At the beginning of each of your turns, you must spend 2 Discipline to maintain concentration of this Kata.

activities.label: Elite Focus
activities.text: Concentration as a B-Rank jutsu; pick two benefits; 2 Discipline at the start of each turn.
